entry_points.text: Adler folds bounded chunks, null yields initial; Nvidia upgrades old compact form for comparison.
Version/modeset and GEM; legacy unique/map/master/ctx/drawable/DMA; AGP/SG/vblank/sequence.
Mode resources/set/atomic/leases; syncobj create and wait.

exports.text: Streaming aliases one-shot; dict/params opaque; static guard equates visibility; small ints and checks complete API.
Stable ABI via numeric ids and fixed layouts for sockets, stats, DRM; legacy dev uses unsigned int.
Signal handlers with default null and ignore one; modifier vendor byte, predicate and masked constructor.
Display mode, async I/O and audit control exposed to user.

hazards.text: Experimental unstable static-only; threading needs build; comp/decomp/reset/end id ranges fixed; flush/end may block.
Stable comp 1-20 and decomp 1-6 incl format/stable/maxblock; window caps; splitter max 6; prime 65521.
Word from long or 32, long-long 64; errors 1-34/35-134 with blocked/deadlock aliases.
Low 2 bits mode, higher create/behaviour incl tmpfile; fcntl dup/query/lock incl OFD; cloexec small.
Huge log shift26 mask 0x3F; ioctl 8/8/14/2; classic term 0x5401-5429; extended type-T packet events.
Prot/map fixed/anon/hugetlb, future lock, advice; tick100 poll bits; dicts outlive, stable no-mutate.
Rlimit 0-15 infinity all-bits; user/kernel origins with fault/trap/child/poll codes; 64 signals fixed.
Socket level1 extended 43-85 filter/pacing/timestamp OLD/NEW+ioctls; term input/output/baud fixed.
DRM caps/prime/events listed; user ptr+len bounded copy; volatile lock bits; some mode ioctls deprecated.
Zero invalid, high-bit big-endian default LE; 16/32-bit RGB orders; packed YUV 4:2:2/4:4:4/10-bit.
Semi-planar luma+chroma and planar 3-plane samplings; vendors 0-12; generic none/linear/invalid.
Intel X/Y/Yf/CC/Gen12/DG2/MTL/LNL/BMG; AFBC nibble+9 flags; isolate vendor/type before low bits.
Names 32 origins; flags polarity/interlace/3D/aspect; power/scale/rot/reflect small; enc/conn sparse; obsolete noted.
Pixel helpers eval inputs multi-times, round vs trunc differ; control block endian-specific.

invariants.text: Cursors in range and advance; zero sequence marks boundary; zero means default with clamping and selectors.
Char/long-long widths; long/pid/uid/gid fixed; size two spellings; offsets split; statfs follows long.
Builders derive size, decoders recover fields; sampled headers use single inclusion guard.
Siginfo number/error/code with arch hooks; timestamp OLD/NEW by time size; term and cap widths fixed.
Fourcc packs bytes LE with guard; modifier vendor top byte; ARM type high with AFBC/fixed/misc.
Count+address enumeration, stable names; connector kind+number; crop fixed-point; ARGB64 16-bit lanes.

locks.text: Flock shared/exclusive, nonblock no-wait, explicit unlock, mandatory/read-write; vendor from 1024.
Volatile hw word padded to cache line; acquire orders drain/ready/quiescent/flush/halt.

state_machines.text: Encode continue/flush/end keeps history then closes; reset session/params/both; decode header/block/final/csum/skip.
Master/ctx/drawable/AGP/syncobj acquire/create, use, release; modeset emits pre notification.
Dumb create, optional map, then destroy with handle identity.

structs.text: Bounds error+limits; buffers base/extent/cursor; sequence offset/lens/repeat; params+frame toggles.
Locks type/whence/offsets/pid; perm/queue key/ids/mode/times; poll fd/masks; sem/shm perms/counts.
Sigval int/ptr; details kill/timer/child/fault/poll/syscall padded; sets longs; action+mask+altstack.
Statfs type/sizes/counts/ids/spares with 64-bit widening; termios flags/controls; winsize rows/cols/px.
Clip/version/maps/stats; DMA out/in lists with granted count; ctx, auth magic, IRQ slot.
Blank req/reply overlay; modeset ctrl/cmd; GEM names; syncobj handles/points/timeouts; events type/len.
Mode timings/flags/name with id arrays; plane ids/rects/masks; encoder/connector kinds; props id/values.
FB id/size/fourcc/planes/modifier; cursor/gamma/LUT/hints; colorops curve/LUT/matrix/mult with blobs.
HDR selectors/chroma/luminance; atomic flags+arrays; dumb create/map/destroy; leases id/fd.
Async opaque handle, vector opcodes, 64-byte block; APM 16-bit events with versioned BIOS states.
SDEI index+base under mask; version major/minor/vendor; errors and routing/status/type/priority.
Audit 1000-1019; filters with prepend/never/possible/always; fields identity/args/key+negate; ops ordered.
